name: TMA Ciliwung-Jatinegara v1 (DSDA)
source: DSDA DKI Jakarta (dump harian lokal data/data-tma)

processing.environment: Python (json aggregation + peak lag analysis, deterministic)

method.name: tma-v1
method.description: station filtering (Ciliwung corridor only), per-event TMA validation vs flood history, empirical peak-to-peak lag Katulampa->Manggarai; Jatinegara estimate = per-km extrapolation (PROXY, low confidence)
